Use cases of Humanity

Real people unlock better systems. Discover practical use cases where verified human identity enables trust, security, and fair participation.

Explore the use cases

Explore the use cases

Why verified human identity matters

Real-world impact across every industry

Decentralized identity is changing how we manage digital IDs. Humanity lets users control their data while proving their humanity without exposing sensitive info.

Users Take Control of Their Identity

Centralized systems create failure points and privacy risks. Our approach lets users share only what’s needed, maintaining security and trust.

Solving identity challenges at scale

This tech supports KYC, healthcare data, gaming security, and supply chain verification - solving real problems with a privacy-first approach.

Powering privacy-first solutions worldwide

Proof of Trust uses zero-knowledge proofs, and decentralized validation to confirm identity without revealing it, already live in multiple industries.
